Authorities Implement Measures for Kanwar Yatra

As the Kanwar Yatra commences, authorities in Sambhal have mandated QR codes and licenses for food and beverage vendors. In Banda, police have issued a traffic advisory, restricting heavy vehicles on routes to Chitrakoot and allowing diversions for smaller vehicles if needed. Meanwhile, security has been heightened along the India-Nepal border in Maharajganj with joint patrols by police and SSB.
